title: Low-temperature methanol-assisted CO2 hydrogenation populating intermediates on Ce-promoted Cu/ZnO/MgO catalyst in three-phase slurry reactor
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00694E, Communication
Vaibhav Pandey, Priyanshu Pratap Singh, Aakash Bhardwaj, Kamal Kishore Pant, Sreedevi Upadhyayula, Siddhartha Sengupta
